sheet.research_rationale: Independent review finds a real original-inventory blocker, despite the machine requires_page_check=false and missing=[] fields. EO12756 section 1 expressly continues the Council until November 13, 1993, superseding the original 24-month sunset candidate November 13, 1991, and section 2 merely raises the section 1(a) membership cap 30 to 35. EO12869 section 4(d) then expressly revokes EO12696 effective September 30, 1993 by section 6, before the extension's end. That likely final date cannot be promoted to a complete all-clause first-end conclusion while original section 4 and independent FACA/other commands are absent from the selected original.

Complete section 4 and the original inventory cannot be confirmed or reconstructed through permitted overrides against this selected original.

Obtain/inspect complete official original pages 54 FR 47507-47508 (PDF pages 11-12), especially all section 4 text, and issue a new dossier only after exact text custody and full inventory are repaired.
